concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-nab-pricing-fees]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree-hosted NAB account pricing snapshot for account-selected blended and IC+ fee treatment, multi-currency settlement/withdrawal conditions, refunds and dispute fees; not a numeric rate schedule, merchant-specific contract, current independent NAB policy, or sibling-account authority
warnings: The source describes the $20 AUD conversion charge both for that day's disbursement and per transfer/withdrawal; preserve this unresolved wording tension and do not infer an effective per-day or per-event charging rule.
